basic_info.description: Ultimate Living by the Beach with space for all the things! Must see in person. One of the brightest homes you will find. Enjoy your massive, exclusive/deeded, private and low maintenance backyard, all to yourself. This is a superb single-family-like condo. A unicorn with 3bd/2ba on main level AND immediate access to the backyard. Inviting open layout w/ sun-filled living room, window seat + fireplace. Spacious Chef's kitchen w/ abundant cabinets + storage. Quiet back bedrooms. The seamlessly integrated downstairs is permitted living space for work, relaxation, entertaining or hosting guests. The building was built for a developers family and no expense was spared. Newer systems, high ceilings, auto blinds, NEST, recessed lighting, modernized/practical and open layout, laundry room, parking, storage, EV charger. NO Monthly HOA DUES! Building owns Solar! What more could you want. PRIME West Side enclave, straddling Outer Richmond, Sutro Heights, Outer Sunset. Surf, bike, stroll Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Lands End Trail or the Great Highway, all just blks away. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets and Balboa Village for dinner and a film at the iconic Balboa Theater, known for cult classics + concerts, or try one of the various restaurants, cafes or wellness options. Very rare to find.
